requirement: Uncorrected or minimally processed feature-intensity matrix
evidence: set.1 is a 761-injection by 567-reconstructed-metabolite numeric matrix. It is peak-picked/aligned/clustered, occurrence-filtered, anonymized, and already log-scaled, but the paper and demo explicitly treat it as uncorrected input.
set.1.Y supplies Batch and globally unique SeqNr for every row. Ten contiguous analytical batches are recovered without alphabetical ordering.
SCode == ref identifies 51 pooled reference QCs; every batch has 5 QCs except B2, which has 6.
SCode identifies 357 anonymized Arabidopsis accessions. There are 351 accessions with two injections, one with three, and five with one.

requirement: Sufficient samples and QCs per batch
evidence: Batches contain 43-75 study injections and 5-6 QCs. Holding out one interior QC per batch leaves 4-5 training QCs and retains both endpoint QCs.

requirement: No evidence the matrix was already batch/drift corrected
evidence: The paper labels the supplied Set I values uncorrected and demonstrates correction from this matrix; the package demo performs corrections after loading set.1.

requirement: Study samples and QCs represented together
evidence: All 710 study injections and 51 QCs occur as aligned rows of set.1 and set.1.Y.
rownames(set.1) and rownames(set.1.Y) are identical and unique.

requirement: Reliable within-batch order and QC endpoints
evidence: SeqNr is unique; within-batch rank is deterministic. Every batch begins and ends with a QC in the retained matrix.

requirement: Biology not severely confounded with batch/order
evidence: 346 of 357 accessions have replicates spanning batches. Eleven accessions do not, including five with only one retained injection; this is recorded and excluded where a paired metric requires replication.
